snippet.title: Codex Lost 2 - Announcement Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
#steam #steamdeck 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3813890?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=announcement&utm_medium=youtube

Magic and intrigue abound in this gripping dark fantasy RPG, with atmospheric exploration that will beguile even the most avid fans of the RPG genre. Wield a diverse array of weapons and spells as you step forth into a world of intoxicating mystery to face the many challenges lurking within.

Somewhere out at the edges of time the last Cathedral of a bygone age sinks into the abyss. In this desperate land only the Orillion Maille - the holy tome - can reuinite the old powers and reverse the end of days.

Heretic, sinner, accursed soul - Heed the call and haul yourself up from the grave. Reclaim the lost codex and stand alone against certain undeath!

- Delve into an intoxicating realm of shadow and splendor, rich with vibrant colour and haunting atmosphere. Chart your own course through a vast, interconnected labyrinth of danger and beauty.

- A diverse arsenal awaits: magic weapons, ancient armors, staves, spells, and curious relics. Layer them with a robust, stat-driven progression system. Craft the playstyle that fits your soul cunning spell-slinger, ironclad battlemage, or madman who charges in with nothing but a stick.

- Weave your gospel of devotion or damnation. Hear the divine murmurs of Gods and the pleas of lowly mortals - yours to heed, hinter or completely rebuke. Consider carefully your interactions with NPCs, or forsake narrative entirely, guided solely by the cold gleam of your blade.

Special Thanks:

🎙 Katiecakes - Voice https://www.youtube.com/@Katiecakes
🎶 #DirtyJazzHands - Sound
